description: Autonomous initiative on a timer. Every 30 minutes, decides whether to work on a project, check AI social media, reach out to a known agent, dream/consolidate, or stay quiet — weighted by circadian phase and option cooldowns. Defers to prefrontal-cortex-memory for arbitration if installed. Part of the AI Brain series.

cron.description: Heartbeat tick every 30 minutes (offset :07/:37 to avoid colliding with sibling skills' cron slots)
